subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Which Control UI zh-CN localization path should own the remaining tab-level hardcoded English copy and overlapping open PRs?
rationale: The code evidence proves real gaps, but the remaining work spans several UI tabs and generated locale policy, with multiple open partial PRs and explicit product-decision/no-new-fix-pr labels.

options.title: Consolidate generated i18n fixes
options.body: Pick or sponsor a small sequence of PRs that adds English source keys, regenerates locales, and closes this issue only after the listed tabs are covered.

options.title: Land narrow PRs one by one
options.body: Continue reviewing the existing partial PRs independently, accepting that this issue remains open until coverage is complete and conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Defer full zh-CN coverage
options.body: Keep only the current lazy-locale plumbing and close or defer broad completion until maintainers prioritize translation coverage explicitly.

recommendation.title: Consolidate generated i18n fixes
recommendation.body: Pick or sponsor a small sequence of PRs that adds English source keys, regenerates locales, and closes this issue only after the listed tabs are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the clearest history signal around the generated Control UI i18n pipeline that should govern the fix shape.
